source.primary_witnesses: **11Q12 (Jubilees from Cave 11; late 1st c. BCE - early 1st c. CE) preserves SPARSE FRAGMENTS of Jub 4-12 — including small portions touching Jub 4:6-11, 4:13-14, 4:16-17 (key Enoch material), 4:29-31.** Where 11Q12 preserves Hebrew, Hebrew is primary; otherwise Ge'ez (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511 critical edition) is primary. Greek not preserved for this chapter.
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Hebrew SBL/Sefaria convention; Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik-VanderKam 1994 DJD XIII codicology + García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII (the 11Q12 editio princeps) + VanderKam 1989 critical Ge'ez + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: García Martínez, Tigchelaar, van der Woude 1998 DJD XXIII (Qumran Cave 11.II) — 11Q12 editio princeps; Milik-VanderKam 1994 DJD XIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: García Martínez, F., Tigchelaar, E. J. C., and van der Woude, A. S., DJD XXIII: Qumran Cave 11.II (Oxford 1998) — editio princeps of 11Q12; Milik-VanderKam 1994 DJD XIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 4 — THE PATRIARCHAL GENEALOGY FROM ADAM TO NOAH; the murder of Abel; the BIRTH OF ENOCH and **ENOCH AS THE FIRST SCRIBE** (Jub 4:17-26) — THE foundational Enoch-as-scribe text. **WITNESS-ATTESTATION**: 11Q12 preserves fragments touching this chapter — most notably some traces around the Enoch material itself. Hebrew DSS witness is FRAGMENTARY but present. **CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY EXTREMELY HIGH**: bidirectional with 1 Enoch + Metatron tradition + 3 Enoch + Sefer Hekhalot — Jub 4:17-26 is THE source-text for the entire Enoch-as-celestial-scribe tradition that later becomes Metatron.

verses.text_geez: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሣልስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቅንአ፡ ቃየል፡ ለአቤል፡ እኁሁ፡ እስመ፡ ይሰዐር፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ አቤል፡ ወላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቃየል፡ ኢተሰዐረ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē qadāmāwi sabuʿ śāləs ʾiyobēləwu qənʾa Qāyāl la-ʾAbēl ʾəḫuhu ʾəsma yəssaʿar ʾəgziʾ lāʿla maśwāʿta ʾAbēl wa-lāʿla maśwāʿta Qāyāl ʾi-tassaʿara
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:1; VanderKam 1989) — 11Q12 not preserved at this verse
verses.notes: **Cain envies Abel because God accepted Abel's sacrifice and not Cain's.** Calendrically dated: end of the 1st week of the 3rd jubilee (year 64). cf. Gen 4:3-5; cf. 1 John 3:12 ('Cain who was of the evil one and murdered his brother'); cf. Heb 11:4. **The motive of envy as cause of the murder is a Jubilees-distinctive specification (Gen 4:5 has Cain's face fall, but no explicit envy-motive).**

verses.text_geez: ወቀተሎ፡ በገዳም፡ ወዜንወት፡ ደሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ለቤዛ፡ ቅትለቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-qatalo ba-gadām wa-zēnnawat damu lāʿla mədr la-ʾəgziʾ la-bēzā qətlatu
verses.notes: **Cain kills Abel in the field; Abel's blood cries out to the Lord for vengeance.** cf. Gen 4:8-10; cf. Heb 12:24 ('the sprinkled blood that speaks better than the blood of Abel'). The blood-cries-out theme.

verses.text_geez: ወረገሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለቃየል፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ደም፡ ዘከውን፡ ቅቱለ፡ ወወሀቦ፡ ኪያሁ፡ በምድር፡ ዘይትገነይ፡ ወይውዕል፡ ይብሉ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ragagamo ʾəgziʾ la-Qāyāl ʾəm-nə mədr ʾəm-nə dam zakon qətula wa-wahabō kiyāhu ba-mədr za-yətgannay wa-yəwʿəl yəblu lāʿlēhu mədr
verses.notes: **Cain cursed from the ground.** cf. Gen 4:11-12.

verses.text_geez: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ርግምት፡ ለዘ፡ ይዘብጥ፡ ካልኦ፡ በዕልው፡ ወይብሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ርእዩ፡ ወእለ፡ ሰምዑ፡ አሜን፡ ወብእሲ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ወኢዜነወ፡ ይኩን፡ ርጉመ፡ ከማሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾənta zəntu ṣəḥuf wəsta ṣəlāta samāy rəgəmət la-za yəzabbəṭ kāləʾo ba-ʿəlw wa-yəblu kwəlomu ʾəlla rəʾəyu wa-ʾəlla samʿu ʾāmēn wa-bəʾəsi za-rəʾəya wa-ʾi-zēnnawa yəkun rəgguma kamāhu
verses.notes: **'For this reason it is written ON THE HEAVENLY TABLETS: cursed is one who strikes his neighbor treacherously.'** **HEAVENLY-TABLETS REFERENCE** — bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary. Murder-curse inscribed in heavenly tablets PRE-MOSAIC — moral law eternal. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Deut 27:24 ('Cursed be anyone who strikes his neighbor in secret') — a Deuteronomic Twelve-Curses formulation, which Jubilees attributes to the heavenly tablets. Also: 'one who saw and did not report shall be cursed like him' — embeds the Levitical bystander-witness-duty (Lev 5:1) in heavenly law.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አንበረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለቃየል፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሎ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረከቦ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu ʾanbara lottu la-Qāyāl təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəqtəlo kwəlu zarakabō
verses.notes: **Mark of Cain.** cf. Gen 4:15.

verses.text_geez: ወአዳም፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይላሕዉ፡ ለአቤል፡ አርብዓ፡ ዓመተ፡ ወበዓመት፡ ራብዕ፡ ሳምን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሣልስ፡ ተፈሥሐ፡ አዳም፡ ወዐርቀ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ካልአ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሴት፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ አቀመኒ፡ ለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ካልአ፡ ዘርአ፡ በምድር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ዘቅቱል፡ እስመ፡ ቃየል፡ አጥፍኦ፡
verses.text_hebrew: ויהיו אדם ואשתו מתאבלים על הבל ארבעים שנה ובשנה הרביעית של השבוע השלישי של היובל השלישי שמח אדם וידע את אשתו ותלד לו בן ויקרא את שמו שת כי אמר הקים לנו אלהים זרע אחר תחת הבל כי הרגו קין
verses.translit: wa-ʾAdām wa-bəʾəsitu konu yəlāḥwə la-ʾAbēl ʾarbəʿā ʿāmata wa-ba-ʿāmat rābəʿ sāmən ʾiyobēləwu śāləs tafaśśəḥa ʾAdām wa-ʿarqa məsla bəʾəsitu wa-waladat lottu kāləʾa walda wa-samayō səmō Set ʾəsma yəbē ʾaqamannī lana ʾəgziʾ kāləʾa zarʾa ba-mədr qərruba zaqətul ʾəsma Qāyāl ʾaṭfəʾo
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 1 lines 1-3 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 207-209) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the mourning-of-Abel + the birth of Seth material; the name שת and the formula 'God has appointed for us another seed' is partly preserved
verses.notes: **Birth of Seth + 40-year mourning for Abel.** **HEBREW WITNESS — 11Q12 fragment preserves portions of this Hebrew text.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 4:25 (the 'another seed in place of Abel' citation). **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: the 40-year mourning period for Abel + the date-fixing (year 4 of week 8 of jubilee 3) anchors Seth's birth in the jubilee-calendar.**

verses.text: ובשבוע החמישי של היובל החמישי הוליד את חנוך לאחיו וקרא את שמו אנוש כי אז החל בני האדם לקרוא בשם השם
verses.translit: ū-ba-šābūaʿ ha-ḥămīšī šel ha-yōbēl ha-ḥămīšī hōlīd ʾet Ḥănōk lə-ʾāḥīw wə-qārāʾ ʾet šəmō ʾĔnōš kī ʾāz hēḥēl bənē hā-ʾādām li-qrōʾ bə-šēm ha-šēm
verses.text_geez: ወበሳምን፡ ኃምስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ኃምስ፡ ወለደ፡ ለሄኖክ፡ ለእኁሁ፡ ወጸውዐ፡ ስሞ፡ ሄኖስ፡ እስመ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ዐሐለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለጸዊዕ፡ በስመ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 2 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 209-210) — Hebrew sparse fragments at this verse; reconstruction follows VanderKam Hermeneia
verses.notes: **Birth of Enosh (אנוש) — 'then began the calling on the name of YHWH.'** Direct citation of Gen 4:26. Jubilees: Enosh = the inaugurator of liturgical cult. **CROSS-CORPUS**: rabbinic tradition (Targum Pseudo-Jonathan, Genesis Rabbah 23:7) reads Gen 4:26 negatively — Enosh = inaugurator of idolatry. Jubilees holds the older positive reading.

verses.text_geez: ወወለደ፡ ቃየናንሰ፡ ለማላልኤል፡ ወወለደ፡ ማላልኤልሰ፡ ለያሬድ፡ ወወለደ፡ ያሬድሰ፡ ለሄኖክ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዐሥር፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡
verses.translit: wa-walada Qāyenānsa la-Malālʾel wa-walada Malālʾelsa la-Yāred wa-walada Yāredsa la-Henok ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-ʿaśr ʾiyobēləwu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:13-16; VanderKam 1989) — Hebrew 11Q12 not preserved at this transition
verses.notes: **Genealogical compression: Kenan → Mahalalel → Jared → Enoch.** Verses 8-15 compress the Genesis 5 Sethite genealogy with calendrical dates. **CROSS-CORPUS**: rewrite of Gen 5:9-20.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ ቃየናን፡ ለሙአሌት፡ እኅቶ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በዓመት፡ ሣልስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ማላልኤል፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa Qāyenān la-Muʾalēt ʾəḫto la-rəʾəsu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-ʿāmat śāləs la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Malālʾel
verses.notes: **SISTER-MARRIAGE PRE-FLOOD: Kenan takes his sister Mualet as wife.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — the sister-marriages of the pre-flood patriarchs are systematically named.** This solves the wives-problem of Genesis 5. cf. Cain-Awan in 3:33 above. The sister-wife pattern is paralleled in 1QapGen, Pseudo-Philo LAB.

verses.text_geez: ወማላልኤልሰ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዲናህ፡ ወለተ፡ ባራኬል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳምን፡ ሣልስ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳምን፡ ሳድስ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ያሬድ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወረዱ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እለ፡ ይሰመዩ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ከመ፡ ይምሀርዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-Malālʾelsa naśʾa lottu Dināhə walatta Bārākēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-sāmən śāləs ba-sadus ʾiyobēləwu wa-waladat lottu walda ba-sāmən sādəsə ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Yāred ʾəsma ba-mawāʿəlihu waradu malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ lāʿla mədr ʾəlla yəssammayu Təguhānə kama yəmharəwomu la-daqiqa sabʾ wa-kama yəgbaru fətḥa wa-rətʿa diba mədr
verses.notes: **MAJOR — 'IN HIS [JARED'S] DAYS THE ANGELS OF THE LORD DESCENDED ON EARTH — WHO ARE CALLED WATCHERS — TO TEACH MANKIND.'** **CRITICAL CROSS-CORPUS — THE WATCHERS DESCEND IN THE DAYS OF JARED.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `watchers-1-enoch-6-11-bnei-elohim-cross-corpus`.** The etymology of יָרֶד Yared from יָרַד yarad 'to descend' is the foundational onomastic pun: 'Jared = he-who-descended' because the Watchers descended in his days. **CRITICAL: in Jubilees the original mission of the Watchers is BENEVOLENT — to teach humanity righteousness and law.** Their corruption (taking wives) comes later. This contrasts with 1 En 6-7 where the Watchers descend specifically to take wives. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 6:6 (Watchers descend on Mount Hermon in the days of Jared); cf. CD 2:18 (Damascus Document on Watchers); cf. 2 Pet 2:4 (angels who sinned); cf. Jude 6. **The Jubilees BENEVOLENT-original-mission framing is doctrinally important — it preserves a place for legitimate angelic-instruction (Enoch, Moses) within the same cosmic-pedagogical economy that produced the Watchers' fall.**

verses.text_geez: ወባራካ፡ ወለተ፡ ራሱኤል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሄኖክ፡
verses.translit: wa-Bārāka walatta Rāsuʾēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu lottu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat wa-samayō səmō Henok
verses.notes: **Jared marries Baraka and Enoch is born.** Jared's wife = Baraka, sister-wife. Enoch's birth: jubilee 11, week 4, year 4 = year 462 from creation.

verses.text_geez: ወውእቱ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ እምነ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘተወልደ፡ ዘተምህረ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወአእምሮተ፡ ወጥበበ፡
verses.translit: wa-wəʾtu qadāmāwi ʾəm-nə daqiqa sabʾ za-wəsta mədr za-tawalda za-tamhəra ṣəḥfata wa-ʾaʾmərota wa-ṭəbaba
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:17; VanderKam 1989) — note: this verse opens the famous ENOCH-AS-SCRIBE PASSAGE which is one of the most widely cited Jubilees-passages in scholarly literature
verses.notes: **ENOCH AS THE FIRST WRITER + THE FIRST RECEIVER OF WISDOM.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUB 4:17 IS THE FOUNDATIONAL ENOCH-AS-SCRIBE-OF-MANKIND TEXT.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `enoch-as-scribe-mediator-figure-12-jub-4-metatron-cross-corpus`.** Enoch = the FIRST human to learn writing (ṣəḥfat), knowledge (ʾaʾmərot), and wisdom (ṭəbab). **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 12:3-4 (Enoch the scribe of righteousness); cf. 1 En 81:5-6 (Enoch's scribal commission); cf. 4Q201-4Q207 Aramaic 1 Enoch fragments; cf. 3 Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot 1-15 where Enoch becomes Metatron 'the great scribe' (Hebrew סופר רב). **This verse is the source-text for the entire Enoch-Metatron-scribe tradition that develops through Hekhalot literature.** **The 'first of humans to write' framing positions Enoch as the heavenly-pedagogue: the secret writing-craft (which the Watchers also taught, see 1 En 8:1) is restored to humanity in legitimate form through Enoch.**

verses.text_geez: ወጸሐፈ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዘከመ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዓመታት፡ ዘከመ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡
verses.text_hebrew: ויכתוב את אתות השמים כסדר חדשיהם בספר למען ידעו בני האדם זמני השנים כסדרם בחדשיהם
verses.translit: wa-ṣaḥafa təʾəmərta samāy zakama śərʿata ʾawrāḫihomu ba-wəsta maṣḥaf kama yāʾmərru daqiqa sabʾ gizē ʿāmatāt zakama śərʿatomu baba ʾawrāḫihomu
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 3 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 210-213) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the ENOCH-WRITING-SIGNS-OF-HEAVEN passage; key vocabulary אתות השמים 'signs of heaven' attested
verses.notes: **ENOCH WRITES THE SIGNS OF THE HEAVENS AND THE ORDER OF THEIR MONTHS.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — ENOCH-AS-CALENDRICAL-SCRIBE.** **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry on 364-day calendar** AND with the Enoch-as-scribe glossary entry. **Enoch invents writing AND the calendar — the foundational link between literacy and chronology.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 72-82 (Astronomical Book — Enoch's astronomical/calendrical revelations from Uriel); cf. 4Q208-4Q211 Aramaic Astronomical Book (the OLDEST Enoch material). **The 'signs of heaven' (Hebrew אתות השמים, Ge'ez təʾəmərta samāy) directly invokes Gen 1:14 ('let them be for signs') — re-anchoring the calendar in creation.**

verses.text: ויהי הראשון אשר כתב עדות ויעד את בני האדם בדורות הארץ והוגד לו את שבועות היובלים בעשר ועשר וירא את חדשי הימים ויספרם ויקרא בשמותם
verses.translit: wa-yhī hā-rīʾšōn ʾăšer kātab ʿēdūt wa-yāʿad ʾet bənē hā-ʾādām bə-dōrōt hā-ʾāreṣ wə-hūggad lō ʾet šəbūʿōt ha-yōbəlīm bə-ʿeśer wā-ʿeśer wa-yarʾ ʾet ḥodšē ha-yāmīm wa-yispərēm wa-yiqrāʾ bi-šmōtām
verses.text_geez: ወውእቱ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ጸሐፈ፡ ስምዐ፡ ወአስምዓ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ትውልዶሙ፡ ለምድር፡ ወትትለበው፡ ሎቱ፡ ሰሙናተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ በዐሥር፡ ወዐሥር፡ ወርእየ፡ ወርኆተ፡ ዕለታት፡ ወኆለቆሙ፡ ወጸውዐ፡ በስማቲሆሙ፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 4 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 213-215) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the 'weeks of the jubilees' arithmetic + 'months of the days' calendrical numbering passage
verses.notes: **ENOCH WRITES THE WEEKS OF THE JUBILEES + MONTHS-OF-DAYS.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — Enoch as the first ASTRONOMICAL-CALENDRICAL author.** The 'weeks of the jubilees in tens and tens' = 49-year jubilees grouped as decades — the Jubilees calendar-arithmetic. Enoch INVENTS the heptadic-jubilee calendar. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 93 + 91:12-17 (Apocalypse of Weeks — Enoch's ten-week + future-ten-week historiographical scheme); cf. 11Q13 (Melchizedek scroll — jubilee arithmetic). **The 'weeks of the jubilees in tens and tens' formula is the structural-mathematical foundation of the entire Jubilees chronology.**

verses.text_geez: ወሤመ፡ ዘመነ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዓመታት፡ በምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሤመ፡
verses.translit: wa-śēma zamana qadāmāwi la-ʿāmatāt ba-məsla malāʾəkta samāy śēma
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:18; VanderKam 1989) — 11Q12 lacunose at this verse
verses.notes: **Enoch sets the calendrical foundations 'with the angels of heaven.'** Enoch-and-the-angels-of-heaven calendrical collaboration. Picked up systematically in 1 En 72-82.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኤድኒ፡ ወለተ፡ ዳኒኤል፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በዐመት፡ ራብዕ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ማቱሳላ፡
verses.text_hebrew: ויקח לו את עדני בת דניאל בת אחי אביו לאשה בשבוע הרביעי של היובל הזה בשנה הרביעית ותלד לו בן בשנה הרביעית של היובל הזה ויקרא את שמו מתושלח
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa lottu ʾEdni walatta Dānʾēl walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-rābəʿ sabuʿ la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu ba-ʿamat rābəʿ wa-waladat lottu walda ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Mātusālā
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 5 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 215-217) — Hebrew partially preserves Enoch's marriage to Edni daughter of Daniel + the birth of Methuselah
verses.notes: **ENOCH'S WIFE NAMED EDNI; SON METHUSELAH.** **Edni** = a Jubilees-distinctive naming. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 5:21-22; cf. 1 Chr 1:3.

verses.text_geez: ወሀለወ፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመታት፡ ወአርአይዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወዘውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወጸሐፈ፡ ኵሎ፡
verses.translit: wa-hallawa məsla malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmatāt wa-ʾarʾayəwo kwəlo zawəsta mədr wa-zawəsta samāy kwənnānē ḍaḥay wa-ṣaḥafa kwəlo
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:21; VanderKam 1989) — Hebrew not preserved at this verse
verses.notes: **ENOCH WITH THE ANGELS OF GOD FOR SIX JUBILEES OF YEARS [= 294 years].** They show him everything on earth and in heaven, including the rule of the sun, and he writes it all down. **CROSS-CORPUS — ENOCH'S COSMIC TOUR**: cf. 1 En 17-36 (the two cosmic tours); cf. 1 En 72-82 (astronomical revelations); cf. 1 En 93:11-14 (Enoch sees God's deep wisdom). **The 6-jubilee number = 294 years matches the Gen 5:22 LXX figure ('Enoch walked with God 300 years') closely; the Jubilees-specific 294 = exactly 6 jubilees gives the calendrical precision.**

verses.text_geez: ወወጥረ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዓመታት፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-waṭra təʾəmərta samāy ba-kama śərʿata ʾawrāḫihomu wəsta maṣḥaf kama yāʾmərru daqiqa sabʾ gizē ʿāmatāt ba-kama śərʿatomu baba ʾawrāḫihomu
verses.notes: **Repetition-formula: Enoch wrote the calendrical-signs.** Resumptive — reinforces the calendrical-scribe identity.

verses.text_geez: ውእቱ፡ ጸሐፈ፡ ስምዐ፡ ወሤሞ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ትውልዶሙ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኩናኔ፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ አበሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አንስት፡ እስመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወዘመው፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wəʾtu ṣaḥafa səmʿa wa-śēmo la-səmʿ lāʿla mədr lāʿla kwəlomu daqiqa sabʾ wa-lāʿla təwlədomu wa-ʾəmənna kwənnānē malāʾəkt ʾəlla ʾabasu məsla daqiqa ʾanəst ʾəsma qadāmi ʾəmuntu ḫadagu śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-zammawu məsla daqiqa mədr
verses.notes: **ENOCH WRITES THE TESTIMONY-OF-JUDGMENT AGAINST THE WATCHERS.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — bidirectional with the Watchers + giants-as-evil-spirits glossary entries.** The Watchers 'abandoned their first ordinance and fornicated with the daughters of earth.' **Direct verbal parallel with Jude 6 ('the angels who did not keep their first estate'); 2 Pet 2:4; 1 En 6-15 in full.** **'WHO LEFT THEIR FIRST ORDER' (ḫadagu śərʿatomu qadāmāwē)** is the exact Greek phrase ἀρχήν ('first estate / dominion') of Jude 6. Jubilees and 1 Enoch are likely both source-texts for Jude's terminology.

verses.text_geez: ወምስለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመት፡ ወአንበረ፡ ስምዓ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፋት፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ትውልድ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-məsla kiyāhu kona Henok sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmat wa-ʾanbara səmʿa ba-wəsta maṣḥafāt lāʿla kwəlomu gəbra təwlədə ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē
verses.notes: **Enoch establishes the testimony in books for all generations till the day of judgment.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — Enoch's books = pre-deluvial scriptural testimony.** This grounds Enochic-literature claims to antediluvian authority. cf. 1 En 81:6, 82:1-2 (Enoch gives his books to Methuselah); cf. 4 Ezra 14:44-46 (the 70 hidden books).

verses.text_geez: ወአዕረገ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኬደ፡ ሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga maśwāʿta qadāmāwē lāʿla mədr ʿəḍa ḥəywat zawəsta bēta maqdas kēda samāy
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:25; VanderKam 1989) — text uncertain; varying VanderKam reading
verses.notes: **ENOCH AS THE FIRST EARTHLY HIGH PRIEST — OFFERS INCENSE IN EDEN-AS-SANCTUARY AT EVENING.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Enoch is the second proto-priest after Adam (cf. 3:27).** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 14 (Enoch's heavenly-temple vision); cf. Heb 11:5 (Enoch translated); cf. Jub 21:7-11 (Abraham's incense list). **The 'tree of life' connection** (the priestly incense uses paradisal wood) embeds the Eden-as-temple typology: Enoch's incense burns wood from Eden's holy trees.

verses.text_geez: ወሤሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ለትትዐውቅ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይዜምዉ፡ ወይትዐደው፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወከመ፡ ይምጻእ፡ ድልወት፡ ለቅቱል፡ ወዘይዜምዉ፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ይትኰነኑ፡
verses.translit: wa-śēmo ʾəgziʾ la-səmʿ lāʿla kwəlu təwlədə la-tətʿawwəq kwənnānē lāʿla kwəlomu ʾəlla yəzēmmuwə wa-yətʿaddawə śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-kama yəmṣāʾ dəlwat la-qətul wa-zayəzēmmuwə məsla ʾanəst yətkwannanu
verses.notes: **Enoch as witness against Watchers + judgment-warning for all who fornicate.** Watchers' sin is twice over: (1) transgressing their first order and (2) fornication with women.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአት፡ ኪያሁ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወወሰድናሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ለክብር፡ ወለስብሐት፡ ወናሁ፡ ሀሎ፡ በህየ፡ ይጽሕፍ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወሥርዐተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወኵሎ፡ እከያተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾat kiyāhu ʾəm-nə māʾkala daqiqa sabʾ wa-wasadnāhu wəsta ganata ʾEdom la-kəbər wa-la-səbḥat wa-nāhu hallo ba-həya yəṣəḥəf kwənnānē wa-śərʿata ʿālam wa-kwəlo ʾəkayāta daqiqa sabʾ
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 4:23; VanderKam 1989) — variant reading per VanderKam
verses.notes: **ENOCH TAKEN UP INTO THE GARDEN OF EDEN FOR GLORY AND HONOR — REMAINS THERE WRITING JUDGMENT.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Enoch's TRANSLATION IS TO EDEN, not directly to heaven.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 5:24 ('Enoch walked with God and was not, for God took him' — ambiguous); cf. Heb 11:5 (Enoch translated, did not see death); cf. 1 En 70-71 (final-form Enoch ascends to heaven and is identified with the Son of Man — a LATER tradition); cf. 4Q227 frag 2 (Pseudo-Jubilees: 'and Enoch was taken... and showed... the kingdom of heaven'); cf. Sirach 44:16, 49:14. **Jubilees places Enoch SEMI-PERMANENTLY in Eden as the celestial scribe — the bridge between Eden-as-temple and Enoch-as-Metatron-scribe.**

verses.text_geez: ወበእንቲአሁ፡ አምጻእ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስመ፡ በህየ፡ ተቀብአ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ትእምርት፡ ለርትዕ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይኰንን፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ትውልድ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾəntiʾahu ʾamṣāʾ māya ʾāyəḫ lāʿla kwəlu mədra ʾEdom ʾəsma ba-həya taqabʾa wa-wəʾtu təʾəmərt la-rətʿ la-kwəlu təwlədə ʿālam kama yəkwannən kwəlo gəbra təwlədə ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē
verses.notes: **FLOOD PROTECTION FOR EDEN: 'because of him [Enoch] the flood-waters did not come on Eden — because he was set there.'** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Eden survives the Flood, protected because of Enoch's presence.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: this Eden-survives-Flood tradition is also in 1 En 65, 4 Ezra 7:36, and rabbinic literature (cf. Bereshit Rabbah 31:11 — Eden was on the highest peak). Eden as cosmic mountain = above flood-line. **Enoch in Eden = perpetual scribe + perpetual high priest until judgment day.**

verses.text_geez: ወአዕረገ፡ ዕጣነ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ መዓዛ፡ በዘይትከበር፡ እምቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ በደብር፡ ጽድቅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga ʿəṭāna qəddusa zaśannāya maʿāzā ba-zayətkabbar ʾəm-qədma ʾəgziʾ ba-dabra ṣədq
verses.notes: **Enoch offers holy incense on the mountain of righteousness.** Eden = mountain of righteousness — explicit identification. cf. Ezek 28:13-14 (holy mountain of God); cf. 1 En 24:3-25:7 (the mountain of God's throne with the tree of life).

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ብሔራት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ገነት፡ ኤዶም፡ ወደብር፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ደብር፡ ዘሀለውክሙ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ዮም፡ ደብር፡ ሲና፡ ወደብር፡ ጽዮን፡ ይቄድስ፡ በፍጥረት፡ ሐዲስ፡ ለቅድሳተ፡ ምድር፡ በእንተዝ፡ ትትቄደስ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ርኵስ፡ በትውልደ፡ ዓለም፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma ʾarbāʿtu bəḥērāt qəddusāt la-ʾəgziʾ ganat ʾEdom wa-dabra məśrāq wa-zəntu dabr za-hallawkəmu lāʿlēhu yom dabr Sina wa-dabra Ṣəyon yəqeddəs ba-fəṭrat ḥaddis la-qədsāta mədr ba-ʾəntazə tətqeddas mədr ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu rəkws ba-təwlədə ʿālam
verses.notes: **FOUR HOLY PLACES OF THE LORD: (1) GARDEN OF EDEN, (2) MOUNT OF THE EAST, (3) MOUNT SINAI [on which Moses is standing], (4) MOUNT ZION. ZION WILL BE SANCTIFIED IN THE NEW CREATION.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUBILEES SACRED-GEOGRAPHY**: the four holy mountains of the cosmos. **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `jerusalem-as-omphalos-center-of-the-earth-1-enoch-26-cross-corpus`.** **The 'new creation' eschatology** picks up Jub 1:29; cf. Isa 65:17, 66:22; cf. 1 En 72:1, 91:16; cf. 2 Pet 3:13; cf. Rev 21:1. **The Sinai-Zion-Eden-Mountain-of-East geography** is the cosmographic foundation of the entire book.

verses.text_geez: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፪፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ብእሲተ፡ እዳና፡ ወለተ፡ አዙራ፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ላሜክ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ ʾiyobēləwu za-2 naśʾa lottu Mātusālā bəʾəsita ʾEdānā walatta ʾAzurā walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-waladat lottu walda wa-samayō səmō Lāmek
verses.notes: **Methuselah marries Edna; Lamech is born.** Continued genealogical detail.

verses.text_geez: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፫፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ላሜክ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ቤትኖስ፡ ወለተ፡ ባራኬል፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ኃምስ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይቤ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ያሳርሐነ፡ እምነ፡ ግብር፡ ወእምነ፡ ድካመ፡ እደዊነ፡ ወእምነ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ረገማ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ ʾiyobēləwu za-3 naśʾa lottu Lāmek bəʾəsita Bētənos walatta Bārākēl walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-zəntu sabuʿ ba-ʿāmat ḫāməs wa-samayō səmō Noḫ wa-yəbē zəntu yāsārəḥana ʾəm-nə gəbər wa-ʾəm-nə dəkāma ʾədawina wa-ʾəm-nə mədr ʾənta ragamā ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Birth of Noah; Lamech names him 'this one shall comfort us from our work and from the labor of our hands and from the earth which Yahweh cursed.'** cf. Gen 5:28-29. The Noah-name etymology (נֹחַ Noaḥ ← נחם nḥm 'comfort') is preserved.

verses.text: ובסוף תשע מאות שלשים שנה תשעה עשר יובלים שבעה שבועים ושתי שנים בו ביובל מת אדם וקברו אותו כל בניו בארץ בריאתו והוא היה ראשון נקבר בארץ
verses.translit: ū-bə-sōp təšaʿ mēʾōt šəlōšīm šānāh tišʿāh ʿāśār yōbəlīm šibʿāh šābūʿīm ū-šətē šānīm bō ba-yōbēl mēt ʾĀdām wa-yiqbərū ʾōtō kol bānāyw bə-ʾereṣ bərīʾātō wə-hūʾ hāyāh rīʾšōn niqbar bā-ʾāreṣ
verses.text_geez: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ፱፻፴፡ ዓመት፡ ፲፱፡ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ፯፡ ሰሙናት፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ቦቱ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሞተ፡ አዳም፡ ወቀበርዎ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድረ፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ኮነ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዘተቀብረ፡ በምድር፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 6 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 218-220) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the death-of-Adam material with the date-formula partially extant
verses.notes: **DEATH OF ADAM AT 930 YEARS = JUBILEE 19, WEEK 7, YEAR 6.** **HEBREW WITNESS via 11Q12.** Adam dies 70 years short of 1000 — **anchoring the 'day of 1000 years' tradition.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — '1 DAY = 1000 YEARS' TRADITION**: 'in the day you eat of it you shall die' (Gen 2:17) — Adam dies in 'day' = millennium. cf. Ps 90:4 ('a thousand years in your sight are as yesterday'); cf. 2 Pet 3:8 ('one day with the Lord is as a thousand years'); cf. Jub 4:30 below. **'The first to be buried in the earth'** — Abel was killed but not buried in the same way; Adam = first formal burial.

verses.text: וחסר משבעים שנה משבעת מאות שנה כי שבעת מאות שנה הם יום אחד בעדות השמים ועל כן כתב על העץ אשר ביום אכלך ממנו תמות לכך לא השלים את שנות היום ההוא כי בו מת
verses.translit: wə-ḥāsēr mi-šibʿīm šānāh mi-šibʿat mēʾōt šānāh kī šibʿat mēʾōt šānāh hēm yōm ʾeḥād bə-ʿēdūt ha-šāmayim wə-ʿal kēn kātab ʿal hā-ʿēṣ ʾăšer bə-yōm ʾākəlkā mim-mennū tāmūt lā-kēn lōʾ hišlīm ʾet šənōt ha-yōm ha-hūʾ kī bō mēt
verses.text_geez: ወአጐሰ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ዓመተ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ምእት፡ ዓመት፡ እስመ፡ ፲ ምእት፡ ዓመት፡ ይከውኑ፡ ዕለተ፡ አሐደ፡ በስምዐ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዕፅ፡ በዕለት፡ ዘበልዕከ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ሞተ፡ ትመውት፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢፈጸመ፡ ዓመተ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሞተ፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 7 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 220-222) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the '1000 years = 1 day' arithmetic and the 'in the day you eat you shall die' citation
verses.notes: **1000 YEARS = 1 DAY 'IN THE TESTIMONY OF HEAVEN.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE THOUSAND-YEAR-DAY MIDRASH IS EXPLICIT HERE.** Jubilees provides the foundational hermeneutic: 'in the day you eat of it you shall die' (Gen 2:17) is fulfilled because Adam dies short of a millennial-day. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Ps 90:4; cf. 2 Pet 3:8; cf. Epistle of Barnabas 15:4 (cosmic week = 7000-year history); cf. b. Sanhedrin 97a (6000 years of the world). **The cosmic-week chronology is one of the foundational Christian eschatological frames; Jubilees is a primary Second Temple source.**

verses.text: ובסוף היובל הזה הוכה קין באבן באבן ויהי כי קין הרג להבל באבן ובאבן נכה הרג במשפט צדק
verses.translit: ū-bə-sōp ha-yōbēl ha-zeh hukkāh Qayin bā-ʾeben bā-ʾeben wa-yhī kī Qayin hāraḡ lə-Hebel bā-ʾeben ū-bā-ʾeben nukkāh hāraḡ bə-mišpaṭ ṣedeq
verses.text_geez: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ተቀትለ፡ ቃየል፡ በበረድ፡ በበረድ፡ ወእስመ፡ በበረድ፡ ቀተሎ፡ ለአቤል፡ ወበበረድ፡ ተቀትለ፡ በፍትሕ፡ ጽድቅ፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 7 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 222-224) — Hebrew fragmentarily preserves the Cain-killed-by-stone material
verses.notes: **DEATH OF CAIN BY HIS OWN HOUSE'S COLLAPSING STONES — measure-for-measure.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Cain dies by STONES because he killed Abel with a stone.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — MEASURE-FOR-MEASURE PRINCIPLE**: 'with the instrument by which he sinned, by it he shall be slain in righteous judgment.' **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Sotah 1:7 ('with the measure that a man measures it shall be measured to him'); cf. Matt 7:2; cf. Matt 26:52 ('those who take the sword shall perish by the sword'). The Hebrew text suggests באבן 'with a stone' for both Abel's death (Gen 4:8 silent on weapon) and Cain's death. **Jubilees here is the FIRST attested source for the Cain-killed-by-stones tradition** — picked up in Pirqe d'Rabbi Eliezer 22, Bereshit Rabbah 23:4.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በመጠን፡ ዘመነኔ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ይትመነን፡ ወከመ፡ ቅትለቱ፡ ይትቀተል፡ ወበልኪቱ፡ ይሰፈር፡ ላዕሌሁ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ba-maṭan zamannāyē kiyāhu yətmannan wa-kama qətlatu yətqattal wa-ba-ləkitu yəssaffar lāʿlēhu
verses.notes: **'For this reason it is written ON THE HEAVENLY TABLETS': measure-for-measure justice is heavenly-tablet-law.** **HEAVENLY TABLETS — third explicit citation in this chapter.** Bidirectional with v2.67.0 heavenly-tablets glossary entry.

verses.text_geez: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ካልእ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኖኅ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኤምዛራ፡ ወለተ፡ ራኬኤል፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለሰቡዕ፡ ኃምስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሴም፡ ወበራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ካልአ፡ ሰመዮ፡ ሐም፡ ወበኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ካልአ፡ ይአፌት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ kāləʾ ʾiyobēləwu naśʾa lottu Noḫ bəʾəsita səmā ʾEmzārā walatta Rākēʾēl walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-sabuʿ ḫāməs la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-waladat lottu walda ba-śāləs ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Sēm wa-ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat kāləʾa samayō Ḥam wa-ba-ḫāməs ʿāmat kāləʾa Yāfet
verses.notes: **NOAH MARRIES EMZARA; SHEM, HAM, JAPHETH BORN.** **NOAH'S WIFE NAMED EMZARA** — Jubilees-distinctive (Gen-silent). **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 5:32, 6:10, 7:13.
